newsitem.title: ITALY: SEAT sale to be finalised by spring - Italy's Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: SEAT sale to be finalised by spring - Italy's Ciampi.

text.p: The sale of Italian yellow pages publishing group SEAT will be completed by next spring, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told parliament on Tuesday.
SEAT was floated off from state-controlled telecoms group Stet at the beginning of this year with state industrial holding IRI holding a 61 percent stake.
"The privatisation of SEAT will be completed by the spring," Ciampi told a joint meeting of the lower house of parliament financial committees.
The business newspaper Il Sole 24 Ore reported at the weekend that four groupings had been shortlisted by the Italian Treasury for consideration in an offer for IRI's stake.

The report, which could not be confirmed, listed U.S. telecom group GTE Corp and ITT Corp, a consortium lead by Dutch bank ABN AMRO with Italian partners, and an Italian consortium group of De Agostini-L'Espresso-Comit.
In December, IRI said that it had received eight non-binding offers for SEAT from 21 individual bodies. SEAT publishes yellow page telephone directories in Italy.
